name: Artifact Pipeline

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Build artifact
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          echo "built on $GITHUB_SHA" > dist/output.txt
      - name: Upload artifact
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: dist/

  consume:
    needs: build
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Download artifact from build job
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: build-output
          path: dist
      - name: Use artifact
        run: cat dist/output.txt

part.text:
Created `.github/workflows/artifact-pipeline.yml`.

The key pieces: the `build` job uploads with `actions/upload-artifact`, and `consume` declares `needs: build` so it runs only after, then downloads the named artifact. Same-run artifacts are automatically shared, so no token/config is needed.

To trigger it locally on push, commit and push to `main` (or run it manually via `workflow_dispatch`).
